about.title: About Takt
about.sub: Takt is a conductor for your agents: one chat, a score of steps, and the performers in plain sight.
about.author: Author
about.description: Takt puts Claude Code in the conductor's seat and hands tasks to the performers — Codex, Antigravity, Claude — each in its own worktree. The plan, step-by-step progress, performers' questions and subscription limits are visible in one window, with no zoo of terminals.
support.title: Support the author
demo.user: Add a bridge to the terminals: Codex and agy must go through a PTY, not raw stdout, otherwise we lose colour and input.
demo.assistant: Got it. These are two independent parts, so I'll split them into separate worktrees: Codex builds the PTY bridge on the Rust side, Antigravity draws the terminal panel in the UI. I keep the plan, review and merge.
